name: Big Cartel
notes: 4-step wizard mapped on sanjosestickers.bigcartel.com; checkout load is flaky run-to-run and an invisible hCaptcha is present.

steps.billing: Wizard (Cart → Details → Shipping → Payment). Advance via 'Next' twice.
steps.payment: The Stripe frame PRELOADS early — advance through the wizard steps without filling the card, then fill at the final step. Card-number token, then the CVV token immediately after.

gotchas: Checkout load is flaky (sometimes no Details form renders) — RETRYABLE, re-navigate up to 3×.
hCaptcha-invisible is present; if it fires, that is a DEAD-END — hand off.

The 'Add to Cart' → 'Check Out' step is unreliable across stores: on 2026-07-20 four of five fresh Big Cartel stores (ydxart, kurt, chooshop, stickerpus) stalled at level `detect` with 'could not reach checkout' on in-stock, sub-$4 products. Treat Big Cartel add-to-cart as needing verification per store rather than assuming the platform flow holds.

Gateway is per-store, not platform-wide: astray3.bigcartel.com is PayPal-only (live-classified paypal-only, no card fields ever mount) while sanjosestickers.bigcartel.com runs Stripe. Recon the gateway before assuming a card path exists.
